summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned 'Recent Projects' Pentagram-style editorial section on the Paper Hoof homepage. All 7 acceptance criteria pass: section renders below hero, all 6 cards (Burger Hot, Odera, Yaloo, Woodland Publishing, Burrowed, DHCH) display with images, pill tags inside the top-left of the image (.rp-media .rp-tag), and title+muted description below; IntersectionObserver applies 'is-visible' to all cards after scroll; click on card-1 navigates to /work/burger-hot; section header reads 'Recent Projects' with a 1px divider line beneath; desktop (1440px) uses a 12-column grid (12 tracks observed), mobile (390px) collapses to single-column with tags still inside images; zero console errors/warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: RecentProjects.jsx: IntersectionObserver effect runs only once on mount with empty deps; if `projects` ever becomes dynamic this would miss new cards. Currently fine since mock data is static.

Staggered transitionDelay (0-400ms) can leave a card at intermediate opacity (e.g. 0.2-0.6) mid-transition when measured immediately after entering viewport — visually correct, just worth noting for any future snapshot tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Recent Projects section verified end-to-end on desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844). data-testids in use: recent-projects-title, project-card-1..6. Tag selector: .rp-media .rp-tag. Reveal class: .rp-card.is-visible. Card click route pattern: /work/{name-lowercased-hyphenated}. No backend involved; all data from mock.js.
